comparison.objective: Open a service door beyond about 80 degrees and lift it off lift-off hinges; candidate removes insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Articulated door opening followed by coordinated heavy lift and hinge disengagement versus precision bimanual hammering and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Door sufficiently open and removed from hinges versus four valid tang fractures and containment with retained components intact. Other door safety thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Hinge disengagement and door handling test a different mechanism and outcome.
